banner.title: Take Trainflow everywhere with you
banner.description: Download the native Android app to track your trains live, receive platform and delay alerts, and check your speed onboard.

features.title: Everything you can do with the application
features.subtitle: Enjoy a seamless travel experience and stay one step ahead, both at the station and onboard.

speed.title: Track your train speed in real-time
speed.description: Watch your train's exact live speed right from your seat and trace your progression in real-time across the map.

platform.title: Beat the station crowd to the platform
platform.description: Get notified the second your departure platform is assigned, so you can board calmly before everyone else.

stopAlert.title: Never miss your stop again
stopAlert.description: See upcoming stations along your route and get a helpful chime right before reaching your destination.

delays.title: Stay ahead of delays & network status
delays.description: Get a complete overview of national train traffic, spot disruptions early, and travel stress-free.

steps.title: How to install the app in 3 simple steps?

step1.title: Download the APK file
step1.description: Tap the download button above to save the trainflow-*.apk file to your Android phone.

step2.title: Open the downloaded file
step2.description: Go to your phone notifications or open the Downloads / My Files app and tap the APK file.

step3.title: Authorize installation
step3.description: If Android displays a warning, accept « Allow from this source » and tap Install. The app is ready!
